title: Enforce questions-only coaching in code, and trim what the conversation coach sends

source.ref: Review of the Codex AI coaching overhaul, 2026-10-26

detail: Coaching questions from the model were accepted if they merely ended in a question mark, so a question quoting replacement copy passed. The Space, writing and listing question parsers and the conversation coach now reject any question or check containing a double quote. The conversation coach no longer sends author names to the vendor, the Space coach profile fields pass through the same cleaning as the About text before they reach the prompt, legacy model-drafted winback proposals no longer block a fresh proposal for the same member, and two importer review strings no longer promise a mood picker that was removed. Left open: the discovery consent write is a read-modify-write that two quick toggles could interleave. 2026-10-26: reviewed-ID projection supersedes punctuation-only validation in Space/shared/Practice/Journey coaching (SCAN-1164). This row now probes actual output consequences plus the retained conversation transcript/quote boundary instead of requiring removed regex source tokens. Conversation free-text semantic guidance remains separately audited; no global ghostwriting guarantee is inferred.

verify.note: Actual provider-boundary projection rejects invented/quoted/unquoted model wording, unknown IDs and extra fields; restoring arbitrary text fails acceptance. Actual conversation transcript excludes author names/internal notes and stays bounded; existing quoted-guidance predicate remains wired. Replaces stale regex-token presence assertions after reviewed-ID projection.
